    • calculateRoute

      public void calculateRoute()
      Calculates the optimal route for the bike. If there is enough battery to reach the target, it changes the rechargingLocation to null. If there isn't enough battery to reach the target, it attempts to find an intermediate BikeStation and sets it as the rechargingLocation.

    • getStringRoute

      Returns:

    • enoughBattery

      public boolean enoughBattery(Location endLocation)
      Checks whether the current battery level is sufficient to reach a given Location. The bike consumes EBCompany.MOVINGCOSTws per step so it could travel up to batteryLevel / EBCompany.MOVINGCOST steps.
      Parameters:
      endLocation - , The Location checked as destiny.
      Returns:
      true if the destiny is reachable and false otherwise.

    • recharge

      public Dock recharge()
      Simulates the recharging process when the bike arrives at its rechargingLocation.

      If the station has a free Dock, the bike occupies it, the battery is charged to full capacity, the cost is calculated, and the station is marked as visited. If there is no free dock, the method returns without making any change.

      On a successful recharge, wsCharged, idleCount, chargesCount and chargesCost are updated accordingly.

    • reduceBatteryLevel

      public void reduceBatteryLevel()
      Reduces the battery level by the cost of one movement step (defined in EBCompany.MOVINGCOST).

    • act

      public void act(int step)
      Carries out a single step of the bike's actions. Moves one step towards the target (recharging or final) or stays idle.

      If no recharge is needed, it notifies when approaching the target destination and moves forward.

      If a recharge is needed, checks if it can recharge and show when it does, if it is far from the station, moves, if possible, one step closer.

      Finally, it prints the bike's current status to the console.

      Parameters:
      step - The current step of the simulation.
